edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender becomes owner and initial reflection holder.
onlyOwner modifier checks _msgSender against _owner for lock.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender.
unlock compares now against _lockTime, a timestamp dependency.
lock sets _lockTime = now + time, timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router.
time parameter directly determines the new _lockTime.
lock writes _lockTime from now + time.
lock stores current _owner into _previousOwner.
lock zeroes the current _owner address.
unlock reads _previousOwner to restore ownership.
unlock writes _previousOwner back into _owner.
Owner-only setter changes pancakePair used in fee logic.
Owner-only setter changes the pancakeRouter used for external calls.
Owner-only setter modifies _taxFee.
Owner-only setter modifies _liquidityFee.
Owner-only setter recomputes _maxTxAmount.
Owner-only setter toggles swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
Owner-only setter flips fee exemption to true.
Owner-only setter flips fee exemption to false.
Owner-only exclusion mutates _isExcluded and _excluded.
Owner-only inclusion mutates _isExcluded and _excluded.
changeLimit flips the limit flag controlling transfer restrictions.
Constructor assigns _rTotal into _rOwned of the deployer.
Constructor initializes _rTotal from MAX and _tTotal.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom subtracts amount from the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
_getValues derives tFee via _taxFee multiplication.
_getValues derives tLiquidity via _liquidityFee multiplication.
_getValues uses _getRate division for r values.
_takeLiquidity multiplies tLiquidity by the current rate.
_maxTxAmount is enforced inside _transfer.
limit flag gates the early transfer amount restrictions.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether takeFee is applied.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates automatic swap triggering.
pancakePair is compared against from/to to avoid circular swaps.
contract token balance drives the overMinTokenBalance trigger.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify which performs external ETH transfers.
inSwapAndLiquify guard prevents recursive swapAndLiquify execution.
amount parameter flows through the transfer logic.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _reflectFee after balance updates.
_tokenTransfer indirectly accumulates liquidity tokens.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates fees influenced by _taxFee.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rTotal.
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller reflection balance.
expectedRewards iterates _excluded to sum excluded balances.
expectedRewards divides by _tTotal minus excluded/pair balances.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for the swapped portion.
swapAndLiquify captures initialBalance before swapping.
swapAndLiquify computes the ETH share to distribute.
External ETH transfer to wallet can invoke receiver code.
External ETH transfer to rewardsWallet can invoke receiver code.
Router swap call is an external call that could re-enter the token.
Router addLiquidityETH call is an external value-bearing call.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the remaining ETH.
receive accepts ETH from the router during swap and liquify.
tokenAmount parameter flows into the router swap call.
ethAmount parameter flows into the router liquidity value.
pancakeRouter is used to execute the token to ETH swap.
pancakeRouter is used to execute the liquidity addition.

normalization_plan.reason: Lock duration is only meaningful as input to the lock function writing _lockTime.
Transfer amount only has semantics inside the _transfer accounting flow.
Token amount is consumed directly by the router swap performed in swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount is consumed directly by the router addLiquidityETH call.
Local ETH snapshot only exists within the swapAndLiquify computation.
Local ETH share is computed and distributed solely inside swapAndLiquify.
Contract token balance is only used to trigger swapAndLiquify from _transfer.
